fresh_comparison.reason: E4 downdate artifacts measure analytic transport amplification; they do not execute or save a signed incremental state

existing_summary_audit.aggregator_limitation: aggregate_stability retains only the final controlled-spectrum record, so checkpoint-level fresh/incremental separation must use the raw JSONs. Kernel and downdate payloads are retained in full.

methodology.fresh_baseline: Replay only the deterministic FP64 G/M state construction and compute a fresh factorization plus two triangular solves in the recorded precision at every raw checkpoint.
methodology.incremental_excess_definition: signed scalar diagnostic gap: raw_relative_error - fresh_relative_error
methodology.non_additivity_warning: Normwise forward errors do not add. The signed scalar gap is not ||incremental_state - fresh_state||. Because E4 did not save tensors, that direct norm is unavailable except where the protocol itself freshly resets state.
